remarks: Welcome to Fillow Ridge, an exceptional townhouse community in West Norwalk offering comfort, convenience, and an unbeatable location. Just a short stroll to the scenic greens of Oak Hills Golf Course, this residence is set in one of the area's most desirable neighborhoods.  Inside, the main level welcomes you with an expansive living room centered around a charming fireplace, creating a warm and inviting setting. Sliding glass doors open to a private deck, providing the perfect extension of your living space for relaxing or entertaining outdoors. The generously sized dining area flows effortlessly into the kitchen, making gatherings both comfortable and convenient.  The sun-filled eat-in kitchen offers abundant space for cooking and casual dining, complete with pleasant views that enhance the experience. Upstairs, the tranquil primary bedroom features oversized windows and an entire wall of closets for excellent storage. The second bedroom is equally bright and spacious, offering both a walk-in closet and an additional closet. A well-appointed Jack & Jill bathroom connects the two bedrooms and includes a separate shower, soaking tub, and dual sinks for added comfort and functionality.  Additional highlights include a pull-down attic for extra storage and ample unassigned parking for residents and guests. Fillow Ridge combines everyday practicality with a prime West Norwalk location, making it a wonderful place to make a home. Close to all the areas amenities.
